svg.text: Keep this. It is the whole thing.
There is no power button. The case is the switch.
Open the lid — they wake up
Orange — still charging, or seated wrong
Flashing orange — they are not sitting on the
charging pins. Take them out and reseat them.
Only the first time. After that they connect themselves.
Open the Even app and sign in.
Take the glasses out of the open case.
They are only discoverable while awake.
Pick your G2 from the list the app finds.
Wait for it to say Connected.
Use the ring. Your temple does the same things — but reaching up is a tell, and the customer sees it.
Type size check (for us, not you)
Back to the cue. Again to finish
Takes it — replies On my way
Only you can see it. It is not a screen the customer can read over your shoulder.
Stays put on the left while you scroll.
Three lines. Never more — you are talking, not reading.
CUE 1/7 means card one of seven.
Take them off and put them back on.
Check the Even app says Connected.
You were in Even's own menu, not Cue. Press twice to come back.
Tell your manager. Do not factory reset them.
